endings.label: A new alert came over it

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.help: A single line at the top of the card; what doesn't fit gets an ellipsis. Empty becomes "Notification".

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.help: Explanation under the title, across multiple lines; a line break is fine. Empty is fine.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.help: A name from the list, also as mdi:name or as a hex codepoint (F12E6). Unknown or empty gives the warning triangle.

fields.name: color
fields.label: Color
fields.help: One of the nine pastel colors of the tiles. Empty gives the white card.

fields.name: button_text
fields.label: Button text
fields.help: The text on the button. Empty is "OK".

fields.name: timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: Seconds after which the card disappears on its own. 0 waits for the button, however long that takes. The button always closes it immediately, even with a timeout.

fields.name: flash
fields.label: Blinking
fields.help: On makes the backlight blink four times when the alert arrives; the screen then just stays on.

camera.name: camera
camera.label: Camera
camera.help: A camera or image entity. Every screen but the CYD, with firmware 0.2.57+, shows its picture of that moment on the card, in the proportions of the camera itself (above the words, or beside them on a wide, low screen); a tap on it opens the camera full screen. The CYD shows the alert without it. Only through the esp_screens_show_alert event.

screen.name: screen
screen.label: Screen
screen.help: Which screen gets the alert: its device name (such as kitchen-screen), the name Home Assistant shows, or a room, which reaches every screen in it. A list, such as [kitchen-screen, hallway], reaches several. Leave it out for every screen. A name that matches no screen sends nothing; the Tessera Screen Manager log names the screens it knows. Only through the esp_screens_show_alert and esp_screens_dismiss_alert events.

action.name: action
action.label: Action
action.help: A Home Assistant action, such as script.open_gate or light.turn_off, performed once when the button is pressed on any screen. `data` gives its fields (entity_id, brightness, ...). A timeout or a new alert leaves it unperformed. Only through the esp_screens_show_alert event.

fields.name: button_color
fields.label: Button color
fields.help: The button in a color of its own: red, orange, yellow, green, mint, blue, purple, pink or gray, as a full key color with white words. Empty keeps the dark button.

fields.name: button2_text
fields.label: Second button text
fields.help: A second button on the left of the first, for a choice such as Decline and Accept. Empty gives one button.

fields.name: button2_color
fields.label: Second button color
fields.help: The second button in one of the same colors. Empty keeps the light button.

action2.name: button2_action
action2.label: Second button action
action2.help: A Home Assistant action performed once when the second button is pressed on any screen, like `action` for the first. `button2_data` gives its fields. Only through the esp_screens_show_alert event.
